name: math-toolchain
description: Subset of the math-toolchain plugin: the lean-shard skill (split a large Lean file into bounded shards plus a coordinator) and the drat-to-lean skill (CNF, CaDiCaL, LRAT, kernel-checked Lean 4 proof), as cited by the Lean build report.

interface.longDescription: The two math-toolchain skills cited by the Lean build report: lean-shard for splitting large Lean files into bounded shards, and drat-to-lean for producing kernel-checked Lean 4 proofs from SAT refutations.
